name: Steakholder Foods Ltd.
summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd., an advanced deep-tech food enterprise, focuses on developing innovative cultivated meat solutions. Its primary goal is to produce cultured meat products without the need for animal slaughter. The company has engineered a sophisticated three-dimensional bioprinter specifically designed to meticulously layer differentiated stem cells, structural scaffolding, and vital cell nutrients, thereby creating structured cultured meat. Moving forward, Steakholder Foods intends to license its proprietary production technology. Additionally, it plans to supply related products, including cell lines, specialized printheads, bioreactors, and incubators. The firm will also offer various services, such as technology setup, user training, and ongoing technical support, to food processors and retailers, both directly and through strategic partnerships. The company's operations are based in Rehovot, Israel.
